What kind of Kabbalistic operation creates the state of intellectual rapture which is the initial stage of the soul's union with God? Three undisputed facts suggest the answer to this question. First, the twelfth thesis states: "non potest operari per puram Cabalam qui non est rational- iter intellectualis."
